FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A01
Suspension parks awhile for fees and presence proofs, while revocation kills outright and demands re-applying with full retests [A01].
Why it matters: group return-paths; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F01, sec13-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A01
DUI, manslaughter, felonies, and impersonation force action, while reckless and aggressive driving merely permit it [A01].
Why it matters: group suspend-lists; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F03, sec13-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A02
Unlicensed driving and test refusal join the may-list, while everyday offenses feed the three-four-six point mill [A02].
Why it matters: group may-points; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F05, sec13-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A02
Under-eighteen stacks clinic, ninety-day suspension, then year revocation across three strikes, while eighteen-nineteen draws only the clinic [A02].
Why it matters: group juvenile-ladder; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F07, sec13-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A02
Twelve in twelve or eighteen in twenty-four orders the clinic, while eighteen in twelve or twenty-four in twenty-four suspends ninety days [A02].
Why it matters: group adult-lines; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A02
Skipped clinics suspend until done, while medical review can suspend, restrict, watch periodically, or close clean [A02].
Why it matters: group clinic-medical; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F09, sec13-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A02
Registration demands coverage proof or five hundred dollars, while medical suspensions uniquely skip presence proofs [A02].
Why it matters: group proof-skips; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F11, sec13-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A03
Insurance lapses suspend over missing proof or kept plates, while support lapses suspend over ninety days, five thousand dollars, or dodged process [A03].
Why it matters: group lapse-triggers; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F12, sec13-F13 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A03
Driving consents to breath tests with three-hour post-crash reach, while refusal or point-oh-eight buys seven, sixty, or hold-till-trial days [A03].
Why it matters: group consent-ladder; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec13-F14, sec13-F15 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A03
Open containers need a stopped car, passenger zone, partial drink, and signs, while child-aboard DUI stacks jail days and fines by repeat [A03].
Why it matters: group alcohol-addons; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F16, sec13-F17 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A03
Alcohol-suspension driving seizes thirty plus ninety days and repeat unlicensed holds three, while DUI wrecks can bill a thousand in responder costs [A03].
Why it matters: group seize-bill; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec13-F18, sec13-F19 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec13-R12 | anchor: A03
Underage point-oh-two drink-driving costs a year plus fine or service, harsher than a first adult admin hold of seven days [A03].
Why it matters: group underage-compare; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec13-F20, sec13-F15 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0032]
